import sys

def to_ternary(n):
    digits = []
    while n > 0:
        digits.append(n % 3)
        n //= 3
    return digits

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    a = int(data[0])
    c = int(data[1])

    a_digits = to_ternary(a)
    c_digits = to_ternary(c)

    max_len = max(len(a_digits), len(c_digits))
    a_digits.extend([0] * (max_len - len(a_digits)))
    c_digits.extend([0] * (max_len - len(c_digits)))

    b = 0
    for a_d, c_d in zip(reversed(a_digits), reversed(c_digits)):
        b = b * 3 + (c_d - a_d) % 3

    sys.stdout.write(str(b) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
